evidence.excerpt: We formalize Agentic Waterfall Feed, a new problem of personalized information discovery in which users actively direct recommendations and the system adapts to evolving needs inferred from both explicit requests and browsing behavior.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: To evaluate systems on this task, we contribute the Agentic Waterfall Dataset and a replay-based evaluation protocol.
